issues.title: Whisper fallback crashes when WHISPER_HF_MODEL is a local path
issues.description: When WHISPER_HF_MODEL points at a local folder that does not exist (the value in .env.example is ./models/whisper/openai-whisper-tiny), _resolve_hf_asr_model() returns the raw path. Hugging Face rejects it as an invalid repo id, so the speech-to-text fallback fails on startup and live class translation has no ASR.

issues.title: Wrong translation cache key mixes up languages
issues.description: explain_material() and ask_question() cache a material's translated text under _translation_cache[body.material_id] — keyed only by material, not by language. A student who requests material X explained in French (cached under key "X") and later requests the same material in Arabic gets a cache hit on "X" and receives the French text back as if it were the Arabic explanation. Silent wrong-language output, no crash — easy to miss unless you check which language actually came back. Analysis only in this demo: the bundled excerpt is real code from the repo, read as text, not executed.

issues.title: Persona chat depends on an unnecessary external API call
issues.description: start_persona_call() POSTs to https://api.bey.dev/v1/calls on every persona-chat start just to mint a session-specific call_id, then builds the chat URL as bey.chat/{call_id} — even though agent_ids are static, pre-created constants already sitting in the PERSONAS list, and bey.chat/{agent_id} works directly, no call needed. Every persona-chat start incurs a network round-trip to a third-party API with its own except Exception: raise HTTPException(502, ...), so any BEY API hiccup (timeout, rate limit, outage) breaks the entire persona-chat feature for a URL that never needed the call. Analysis only in this demo: the bundled file is the real route, read as text, not executed.

issues.title: Force-offline toggle ignored by the network status check
issues.description: check_network_status() branches purely on the static .env value USE_LOCAL_OLLAMA and always returns connected: True — it never calls _is_force_offline(), even though that function (and the runtime "force offline" toggle a teacher can flip in the UI) is defined right above it in the same file. A teacher in a classroom with no internet flips "force offline," but the status check still reports based on whatever USE_LOCAL_OLLAMA happens to be in .env, so the app can keep believing cloud/26B routing is available and try to use it — defeating the toggle. Analysis only in this demo: the bundled excerpt is real code from the repo, read as text, not executed.

issues.title: Wrong exception type swallowed in the 26B thinking-config fallback
issues.description: stream_26b() builds a pydantic ThinkingConfig(**thinking_cfg_kwargs) inside a try/except TypeError meant to fall back on failure — but pydantic validation failures raise ValidationError, not TypeError, so the except clause never actually catches anything. The real error propagates and crashes the 26B streaming call whenever thinking_budget=0 is rejected. (The same historical fix also quieted an unrelated TTS "no voice models found" log that fired on every single request instead of once — bundled here too since it's the same commit, though it's a log-spam fix, not a functional bug.) Analysis only in this demo: the bundled excerpts are real code from the repo, read as text, not executed.

issues.title: Model-tag matching treats different model sizes as interchangeable
issues.description: _model_present() in main.py's /health and is_model_present() in model_client.py both match any installed model whose base name (before the ":") equals the queried one — so checking for "gemma4:e4b" (the deep model) reports present if only "gemma4:e2b" (the fast model) is actually installed, since both share the base "gemma4". The health check / readiness UI can report the deep model as available when only the small one is pulled, letting the app attempt to route to a model that isn't there. (The same historical fix also fixed translate_text_chunk()'s grade_level parsing, which crashed on a non-numeric stored value — bundled here too since it's the same commit.) Analysis only in this demo: the bundled excerpts are real code from the repo, read as text, not executed.
